data.body: Scope addition (post-brainstorm SC6): unit test coverage extended to fallback dispatch — RateLimitError -> alternate provider; ContextWindowExceededError -> next tier-model same provider; full-chain failure -> fallback_exhausted JSON entry; streaming=False preservation across hops; startup-time rejection on missing provider creds. See sibling 298a-8460-3293-41e2 for the contract.
